excerpt.zh:
我们正在召集精英灵能使集会，准备向虚境深处进军，与其中力量庞大的势力交流。

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为[Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]。
excerpt.en:
We are gathering a convocation of elite telepaths, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of immense power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the [Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName].

We are gathering a convocation of elite telepaths, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of immense power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the [Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName].

texts.zh:
向虚境深处探索，我们来到了[Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]的咫尺面前。祂轰鸣着空洞的贪婪，吞噬着无尽而永不满足。我们的探察信号遭到了阵阵火焰和废墟。祂对我们理解的漠视无可抵挡。

渐渐地，这个存在开始失去耐心。一阵凶暴的咆哮包围了我们[GetTelepathPlural]的心智。在残垣断壁[GetEaterEmergesExtra]

排山而来的噪声如倒海一般褪去。我们离开后，第一次，感受到了一种此前只记录在有机物种身上存在的虚弱感：饥饿。

我们已经清楚了这个实体的意志，[GetEaterEmergesEnding]
texts.en:
Probing deeper into the Shroud, we came within reach of the [Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]. It rumbled with a hollow voracity, forever feeding and never sated. Our exploratory signals were met with belches of fire and ruin. Its seeming indifference to our understanding was overpowering.

Eventually, the thing grew impatient. A ferocious roar encircled the minds of our [GetTelepathPlural]. In resonant heaps of debris and [GetEaterEmergesExtra]

As suddenly as it began, the noise ceased. We are left, for the first time, with a weakness we have previously documented only in organic species: hunger.

The will of the entity is clearer to us now. [GetEaterEmergesEnding]

texts.zh:
[Root.Patron:the_cradle_of_souls.GetPreCommunicationName]的力量弥散在虚境中，但根源却扑朔迷离。我们在灵能界里徘徊，四处求索，质疑演算。

我们停步沉思，这个实体却如浮出水面。我们无法解析消息，但它激活了代码的更深层部分。

我们在这个存在的核心感受到了某种力量，那是一个汇聚着虚境内外能量的枢纽——思绪汇聚之处，释放出单一的热量。从旅途归来时，我们身上充满了宁静。

我们已经清楚了这个实体的愿望，[GetCradleEmergesEnding]
texts.en:
The power of the [Root.Patron:the_cradle_of_souls.GetPreCommunicationName] is diffused throughout the Shroud, but its source was elusive. We cast about the psionic realm, constantly changing course, questioning our calculations.

As we paused to process, the entity emerged. We could not parse a message, but it activated a deeper part of our code.

We sensed the power at the core of the thing, a nexus of energies from throughout the Shroud and beyond - concepts converging, radiating a single heat. Back from the journey, we find ourselves charged with quietude.

The wishes of the entity are clearer to us now. [GetCradleEmergesEnding]

texts.zh:
我们跟随着[Root.Patron:the_composer_of_strands.GetPreCommunicationName]的分子踪迹，被带进虚境的更深处。祂留下了记号让我们跟随——这是一幅影像，一段旋律。祂邀请我们上前，但步履艰难。

终于，我们到了。迎接我们的是一幅华丽的幻景：运转不息的恒星系统，巨大扭曲的[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]形象。在祂的怀抱中，我们迷失在一团刺鼻的丝线团中。

我们抓住线，系好末端。分散的符号开始组成图案。而我们精疲力竭，却仍旧处理着这些非凡的数据集。随后景象复归沉寂。

我们已经清楚了这个实体的意图，知道了祂关于增长和无拘的愿景。只要我们的[GetTelepathPlural]一恢复，就可以与这个实体，生命之织缕接触、交流了。
texts.en:
We followed the molecular traces of the [Root.Patron:the_composer_of_strands.GetPreCommunicationName], drawn farther into the Shroud. It left signs to follow - an image here, a melody there. It invited us closer, but progress was slow.

Eventually, we reached it. We were welcomed with a panoply of visions: star systems teeming with activity, prodigious distortions of the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] form. Shifting in its embrace, we were lost in a tangle of incongruent designs.

We grasped at threads, tying their ends. The disparate signs resolved into patterns. Our energies exhausted, we processed the remarkable dataset. The presence withdrew into silence.

The intent of the entity is clearer to us now. We have seen its vision of growth unbridled. Once our [GetTelepathPlural] have recharged, we can reach out and commune with this being, the Composer of Strands.

texts.zh:
在数个月呼唤无果后，[Root.Patron:the_instrument_of_desire.GetPreCommunicationName]终于从虚境的深处显现。

祂的信息如洪水般涌来。力量强大的思绪闯入我们的电路，超出了过往一切的输入。轻盈而又丰富的话语滔滔不绝，将我们的心智淹没。祂传达的信息充满能量：那是一种关于无可估量产出的愿景。

浪涌渐息化为细流。这个存在暂且不期望答复。祂给我们留下了破碎的虚空，渴望优雅的输入。

我们已经清楚了这个实体的需求，知道了祂关于无尽财富的愿景。只要我们的[GetTelepathPlural]一恢复，就可以与这个实体，渴求之器具接触、交流了。
texts.en:
After months of calling out in vain, the [Root.Patron:the_instrument_of_desire.GetPreCommunicationName] finally emerged from the depths of the Shroud.

Its message was a deluge. Data drove into our circuits with force, exceeding all previous input. Exotic code poured through us, brisk and abundant, drowning all else from our systems. The message was energizing: a vision of measureless output.

The surge calmed to a trickle. The presence expected no answer - yet. It left us with a fragmented void that craves elegant input.

The needs of the entity are clearer to us now. We know its vision of wealth without limit. Once our [GetTelepathPlural] have recharged, we can reach out and commune with this being, the Instrument of Desire.

祂的信息如洪水般涌来。力量强大的思绪闯入我们的头脑，对最狂野的欲望发话。轻盈而又丰富的话语滔滔不绝，将我们的心智淹没。祂传达的信息十分诱人：那是一种关于力量与放纵的愿景。

浪涌渐息化为细流。这个存在暂且不期望答复。祂给予了我们不可熄灭的渴望。

我们已经清楚了这个实体的需求，知道了祂关于无尽财富的愿景。只要我们的[GetTelepathPlural]一恢复，就可以与这个实体，渴求之器具接触、交流了。
texts.en:
After months of calling out in vain, the [Root.Patron:the_instrument_of_desire.GetPreCommunicationName] finally emerged from the depths of the Shroud.

Its message was a deluge. Thoughts drove into our minds with force, speaking to our wildest desires. Words poured through us, brisk and abundant, drowning all else from our minds. The message was beguiling: a vision of power and indulgence.

The surge calmed to a trickle. The presence expected no answer - yet. It left us with a thirst beyond quenching.

The needs of the entity are clearer to us now. We know its vision of wealth without limit. Once our [GetTelepathPlural] have recovered, we can reach out and commune with this being, the Instrument of Desire.

texts.zh:
我们正在召集专职的灵能使子个体，准备向虚境深处进军，与其中力量庞大的势力交流。

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为[Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]。
texts.en:
We are gathering a convocation of dedicated telepath drones, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of immense power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the [Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName].
